text.description_html:
Acorn RIRBP, 15-5/8" Bean Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle

The 15-5/8" Bean Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle has a rough iron finish. Its functionality does not overlook appearance. Designed for gates 3 inches to 4 inches thick up to 175 lbs, this iron strap hinge will be sure to add an authentic old world finishing touch to any door. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron.

19-5/8 Inch Bean Tip Rough Iron Strap Hinge For Gates With Wood Screw

Features of the Bean Tip 15-5/8" Strap Hinge:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the Acorn 15-5/8" Rough Iron Bean Tip Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Designed for gates 3" to 4" thick up to 175 lbs.
  • Length: 15-5/8"
  • Width: 1-9/16"
  • Gauge: .155
  • Pintle: 4-1/2"

Sold Individually
